description: Configure this workspace's AI support agent. All fields are optional, only the fields you pass are updated; the rest keep their current values. Call with no fields to just read back the current configuration. Does not touch or return any API keys.

enabled.description: Turn the automated AI agent on (true) or off (false).

greetingMessage.description: First message visitors see when they open the chat. Pass an empty string to clear it.

model.description: Chat model id: 'gpt-6-luna' (default, OpenAI) or 'claude-sonnet-5-5' (Anthropic, only when the platform has enabled it).

providerMode.description: 'platform' = platform-hosted keys (billed via AI credits); 'byok' = bring your own key.

systemPrompt.description: The agent's system prompt / persona and answering rules.

name: configure_agent
title: Configure AI agent
